name: neatmem
description: Cross-session memory for coding agents, backed by a local NeatMem server.

api_url.title: NeatMem server URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the NeatMem server (default http://127.0.0.1:8000).

api_key.title: NeatMem API Key
api_key.description: Optional. Only needed when the server sits behind an authenticating proxy.

user_id.title: Memory user ID
user_id.description: Optional stable ID shared across machines. When omitted, your local account name is used.

top_k.title: Manual search results
top_k.description: Maximum number of memories returned when Claude runs another search after the automatic first search.

max_context_chars.title: Maximum retrieved context
max_context_chars.description: Maximum number of memory characters returned for one search.

search_scope.title: Default search scope
search_scope.description: How wide every search runs by default. 'repo' is the whole repository's shared memory plus your own memories, 'mine' narrows results to memories you saved.
